reference.title: Fantasy Warrior — LuizMelo
reference.use: Pose silhouette only. Own player appearance is the input; no copied reference character pixels.

request.description: Redraw this exact approved player sprite into a strong side-view forward RUNNING CHARGE held pose facing RIGHT, inspired by LuizMelo Fantasy Warrior running silhouette: a LOW forward-pitched torso, head ahead of chest ahead of hips; clear diagonal from rear hip through shoulders to head, about 40 degrees forward from upright. Neck naturally joins tilted shoulders; head looks forward under full eye-covering bangs. Do NOT keep torso upright. Hips stay compact with original short body proportions. Front thigh lifts forward with knee bent and front boot ready to land ahead; rear leg pushes back with bent knee and lifted heel, clear wide readable leg silhouette. Sword is carried in ONE near hand at lower-waist level, forearm low, long straight silver blade pointing almost horizontally forward-right (at most 5 degrees up). Far arm is visible bent close to chest, counter-swinging naturally, no missing arm. Keep exact original female cream-blonde bob, headband, brown uniform with warm gold trim, pleated skirt and brown boots, detailed pixel clusters and original palette. No cloak, hood, armor, curved scimitar or green outfit from inspiration; keep OUR character. Hair and skirt trail behind, cloth remains outside thighs. Same head/limb scale as input, no stretching. Entire body and sword visible on transparent 256x224 canvas. No FX, trails or shadow. This is a coherent newly drawn full-body movement pose, not image-part rotation.

scope: Preview only. User explicitly requested no Unity integration or in-game validation.
